skill.name: nano-banana-2
skill.description: Generate still images with Google Nano Banana 2 through the RunComfy CLI, with prompts, aspect ratios, resolution tiers, web grounding, and output guidance.
skill.summary: Guide RunComfy Nano Banana 2 text-to-image generation from prompt design to CLI execution.
skill.author: runcomfy-com

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown false positives from inline code, tables, and sample prompts. Confirmed risks are legitimate but security-relevant: external RunComfy CLI execution, prompt upload to RunComfy model endpoints, and a repository mismatch in install instructions. No prompt injection or hidden exfiltration instructions were found.

remediation.issue: Install instructions reference a different repository owner.
remediation.suggestion: Update the GitHub link and install command to match the audited runcomfy-com source, or explain the ownership relationship and pin a trusted ref.

remediation.issue: The skill runs a local CLI that sends prompts to an external model API.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation before running RunComfy commands and disclose prompt upload, web search, and output download domains.

remediation.issue: The prerequisite uses a global npm install.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a pinned CLI version or documented integrity checks for the @runcomfy/cli package.

remediation.issue: The login flow creates a local token file.
remediation.suggestion: Keep token path references informational and tell agents not to inspect or print credential files.

content.value_statement: Teams need fast text-to-image drafts with clear controls for aspect ratio, resolution, and web grounding. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to use RunComfy Nano Banana 2 with documented prompts and CLI options.
actual_capabilities: Routes Nano Banana 2 text-to-image requests through the RunComfy CLI.
Documents input fields, output formats, aspect ratios, and resolution tiers.
Provides batch, seed-locked, vertical, and web-grounded invocation examples.
Gives prompt guidance for subject-first composition and quoted in-image text.
Explains endpoint limits, exit codes, token handling, and outbound API domains.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a RunComfy account or token.
Sends prompts to the RunComfy model API over HTTPS.
Supports still image generation only; image editing uses a separate skill.
Higher resolutions and web search can add cost and latency.

use_cases.title: Create Social Drafts
use_cases.description: Generate four vertical thumbnail concepts quickly, then select one for refinement.

use_cases.title: Draft Brand Cards
use_cases.description: Create product cards and posters that include quoted in-image text and controlled framing.

use_cases.title: Refine Visual Concepts
use_cases.description: Use seeds and resolution tiers to move from rough concepts to final still images.

prompt_templates.title: Quick Square Draft
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 1K square PNG with Nano Banana 2 for: [describe subject]. Save the output in [folder].

prompt_templates.title: Batch Social Concepts
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for multiple mobile-first variants.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Nano Banana 2 to create four 9:16 draft variants at 0.5K for: [campaign idea]. Keep the composition simple.

prompt_templates.title: Seed-Locked Final
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 16:9 2K final image using seed [number]. Preserve the main composition and improve: [specific detail].

prompt_templates.title: Web-Grounded Visual
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request that needs current real-world context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Nano Banana 2 with web search enabled to create current-event imagery about [entity or event]. Avoid unsupported claims.

output_examples.input: Generate four vertical thumbnail drafts for a fitness app launch.
output_examples.output: Four 9:16 draft images are saved to the selected folder, with settings suited for fast review.

output_examples.input: Create a product card for a black mug with the headline Brewed Quietly.
output_examples.output: A 16:9 brand card image is produced with the mug centered and the quoted headline placed clearly.

output_examples.input: Create a web-grounded image about a current product announcement.
output_examples.output: A still image is generated using web grounding, with a note that external context increased latency and cost.

best_practices: Use 0.5K for ideation and 1K or 2K for stronger review outputs.
Quote exact text that should appear inside the image.
Enable web search only when fresh information is required.
anti_patterns: Do not use this text-to-image skill for image editing workflows.
Do not request aspect ratios or resolutions outside the documented options.
Do not mix many conflicting visual styles in one prompt.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates still images with the Nano Banana 2 text-to-image endpoint on RunComfy.

faq.question: Does it edit existing images?
faq.answer: No. The skill points users to a separate Nano Banana Edit skill for image edits.

faq.question: What account setup is required?
faq.answer: Users need the RunComfy CLI and a RunComfy account or RUNCOMFY_TOKEN.

faq.question: Can it make multiple versions?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented endpoint supports up to four images per request.

faq.question: When should web search be enabled?
faq.answer: Enable it only for current events or real entities that need fresh context.

faq.question: Where are files saved?
faq.answer: The CLI saves generated outputs to the output directory chosen by the user.
